description: World-first Constitutional Autonomous Decision Engine consuming CASL CHI (Constitutional Health Index) scores and producing cryptographically attested PROMOTE / HOLD / REJECT verdicts. Four subsystems: DecisionMatrix (CADE-GATE-0, CADE-DETERM-0) — deterministic CHI-to-verdict mapping; DecisionLedger (CADE-CHAIN-0, CADE-APPEND-0, CADE-IMMUT-0) — HMAC-SHA-256-chained append-only ledger; AttestationEngine (CADE-ATTEST-0) — HMAC-SHA-256 attestation on all PROMOTE decisions; DecisionAuditor (CADE-AUDIT-0) — append-only HMAC-chained audit log. CADEEngine facade coordinates all four subsystems. HUMAN-0 veto gate (CADE-HUMAN0-0) structurally enforced and non-delegable. 8-endpoint FastAPI router: POST /cade/evaluate, GET /cade/decision/{id}, GET /cade/decisions, POST /cade/veto/{id}, GET /cade/verify-chain, GET /cade/attestation/{id}, GET /cade/audit, GET /cade/matrix, GET /cade/status. Marks beginning of Arc III — Autonomous Constitutional Intelligence.
